exact_statement: For every finite uniform Boolean sign f, C>0, c>=2/ln2, and every finite adaptive tree of nonempty physical block queries with complete uniform-reach children and an actual entropy-preserving full affine/character minimum representative at root and after each query, let D=H-Ca, kappa=log2(1+2^(c-C)), M=sum rho*r, R=sum rho*(E I(raw child)-E a(child)), W=sum rho*D2(P_AB||Ber(theta)^r tensor P_B), G=sum rho*(c I_A-J), and S=-E_leaf D, theta=1/(1+2^(C-c)). Then D(root)+S+C R+W+G=kappa M, with R,W,G>=0. For node events E_v with occupation p_v and actual unconditional exterior references, writing U=sum rho*p_v*W_v,occupied and E=sum rho*(W_v-p_v*W_v,occupied)>=0 gives D(root)+S+C R+G+E+U=kappa M. If D(root)>0 and S>=0, U<kappa M; a supplied V=sum rho*p_v>=eta*kappa M>0 implies U/V<1/eta. Minimal essential dimension at the same C supplies S>=0 only for trees that query every path. Exact nonlinear phase deficit losses pi add sum rho*pi to the right, not a free reset. No original source payment or universal FEI constant is established.
hypotheses: Uniform finite Boolean signs, bits; C>0 and c>=2/ln2
Finite adaptive complete-child query tree, actual original physical reaches
Root and every reset child represented at actual minimum a; no free nonlinear phase
Occupied laws divided only at positive mass; all exterior references are unconditional actual marginals
Nonnegative terminal reserve is either supplied or justified by genuine minimal-essential-dimension criticality; no renewed debit
